question: break down expenses by category this month

question: what is our staff to student ratio

question: admission enquiry conversion rate this year

question: show fee collection trend by month
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(jt.payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS month_label, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS total_collected FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date')) AS jt WHERE jt.payment_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(jt.payment_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_label DESC LIMIT 12

question: which classes have the lowest attendance this month
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS attendance_percent FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY c.class ORDER BY attendance_percent ASC LIMIT 20

question: average exam marks by class
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, ROUND(AVG(ms.exam_marks), 2) AS avg_marks, ROUND(AVG(ms.exam_marks / NULLIF(ms.exam_total, 0) * 100), 2) AS avg_percent FROM mark_sheet ms JOIN exam_schedule es ON es.id = ms.exam_schedule_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = ms.student_session_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id WHERE ms.exam_total > 0 GROUP BY c.class ORDER BY avg_percent ASC LIMIT 50

question: list students at risk academically or financially
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, c.class AS class_name, ROUND(att.pct, 1) AS attendance_percent, COALESCE(fee.balance, 0) AS fee_balance, COALESCE(beh.total_points, 0) AS behaviour_points FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss2.student_id, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss2 ON ss2.id = sa.student_session_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ss2.student_id) att ON att.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.id AS student_id, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS balance FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id GROUP BY s.id) fee ON fee.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.student_id, SUM(sb.point) AS total_points FROM student_incidents si JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id GROUP BY si.student_id) beh ON beh.student_id = s.id WHERE (att.pct < 75 OR fee.balance > 0 OR beh.total_points < -5) ORDER BY fee.balance DESC, att.pct ASC LIMIT 50

question: show negative behaviour incidents this month
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sb.title, sb.point, si.created_at FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id WHERE sb.point < 0 AND MONTH(si.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(si.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY sb.point ASC LIMIT 50

question: online admission applications pipeline status

question: what percent of income goes to payroll
